name: The Catholic Christian Instructed
author: Bp. Richard Challoner
desc: The Catholic Christian Instructed in the Sacraments, Sacrifice, Ceremonies and Observances of the Church (1737), by way of questions and answers: the sign of the cross, the sacraments (baptism, confirmation, the Eucharist and the real presence, penance, extreme unction, orders, matrimony), the Mass, fasting and abstinence, prayers for the dead, images, and the ceremonies and blessings of the Church.
desc_pt: O Cristão Católico Instruído nos Sacramentos, no Sacrifício, nas Cerimônias e nas Observâncias da Igreja (1737), em perguntas e respostas: o sinal da cruz, os sacramentos (batismo, crisma, Eucaristia e presença real, penitência, unção dos enfermos, ordem, matrimônio), a Missa, o jejum e a abstinência, as orações pelos defuntos, as imagens e as cerimônias e bênçãos da Igreja.
editor: Bp. Richard Challoner (New York: D. and J. Sadlier, 1853)
edition: The Catholic Christian Instructed, in the Sacraments, Sacrifice, Ceremonies, and Observances of the Church, by way of Question and Answer (New York: D. and J. Sadlier, 1853), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The author's preface is kept; the contents and the advertisements are dropped. Sections of a chapter are headings within it.
